title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Multifamily Pre-1980
requirement: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 are fully covered, which includes rent control, just cause for eviction, and security deposit interest requirements.
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Single Family Homes Pre-1996 Tenancies
requirement: Single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996 are fully covered for rent control, just cause for eviction, and security deposit interest.
coverage_conditions: single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: Single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Rooming Houses
requirement: Rooming houses defined as single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases are fully covered.
coverage_conditions: single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: Rooming house: single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases**

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - New Construction Post-June 1980
requirement: Units built and receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 are partially covered, meaning they are subject to registration and security deposit interest rules but exempt from rent control and just cause eviction.
coverage_conditions: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980**

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Single Family Homes Post-1996 Tenancies
requirement: Single-family homes with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996 are partially covered, meaning they are subject to registration and security deposit interest but exempt from rent control and just cause eviction.
coverage_conditions: single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: Single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996**

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Condominiums
requirement: Most condominiums are partially covered, subject to registration and security deposit interest but exempt from rent control and just cause eviction.
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: Most condominiums** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Golden Duplex Exemption
requirement: Golden duplexes defined as duplexes owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently having an owner living in one of the units are entirely exempt from the ordinance.
coverage_conditions: duplex that was owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently has an owner living in one of the units
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: “Golden Duplex”: duplex that was owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently has an owner living in one of the units

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Shared Kitchen or Bath Exemption
requirement: Units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property at the time the tenancy started are exempt from the ordinance.
coverage_conditions: unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property at the time the tenancy started
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: Unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property at the time the tenancy started

title: Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - ADU Exemption
requirement: Tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018, on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied are exempt from the ordinance.
coverage_conditions: properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied with tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018
citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
quoted_span: Tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018, on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied.
